notes.title: Update Coming Soon: 4k Support (Custom Resolution), Balance and Performance Fixes
notes.content: A patch scheduled for 7/7/2017 will contain custom resolution support (which means 4k), some network performance fixes, and balancing fixes for both the crossbow and railgun pickup.
